# Chapters Demo

This runbook shows the `<Chapter>` block, which splits a long runbook into chapters shown one at a time. Open **Contents** in the bar below to see every chapter and how many of its steps are done, or move on with the buttons at the end of each chapter.

Content outside every chapter, like this introduction, shows with each of them.

<Chapter title="Set up">

## Name the app

<Inputs id="app">
```yaml
variables:
  - name: AppName
    type: string
    description: The name of the app to deploy
    default: hello-world
```
</Inputs>

## Prepare a workspace

This block writes an output, `workspace`, that a block in the next chapter reads.

<Command
    id="prepare"
    title="Prepare a workspace"
    env={{ APP_NAME: "{{ .inputs.AppName }}" }}
    command='echo "workspace=/tmp/$APP_NAME" >> "$RUNBOOK_OUTPUT" && echo "Workspace ready."'
    inputsId="app"
    successMessage="Workspace ready."
/>

</Chapter>

<Chapter title="Deploy">

## Deploy the app

Chapters only change what's on screen. A block can use the inputs and outputs of blocks in any other chapter, so this one reads the name from the *Set up* chapter's form and the workspace its command prepared.

<Command
    id="deploy"
    title="Deploy the app"
    env={{ APP_NAME: "{{ .inputs.AppName }}", WORKSPACE: "{{ .outputs.prepare.workspace }}" }}
    command='echo "Deploying $APP_NAME from $WORKSPACE" && echo "source=$WORKSPACE" >> "$RUNBOOK_OUTPUT"'
    inputsId="app"
    successMessage="Deployed."
/>

</Chapter>

<Chapter title="Verify">

## Check the deployment

<Check
    id="verify"
    title="Check that the app is up"
    env={{ APP_NAME: "{{ .inputs.AppName }}" }}
    command='echo "$APP_NAME is up."'
    inputsId="app"
    successMessage="The app is up."
/>

## Finish

<Finish
    id="finish"
    description="Marks the runbook finished."
>

You've moved through every chapter. Read the [`<Chapter>` docs](https://runbooks.gruntwork.io/authoring/blocks/chapter/) to split your own runbook into chapters.

</Finish>

</Chapter>
